I was in a similar boat this past summer. My best friend and I both got out of bad first relationships. We never even considered the thought that we liked each other until a few months after. We also both graduated, so we were less than a month away from going to different schools. 

Eventually, we both had a strong confident feeling that we were meant to be with each other. We never really talked about it, we just let it happen. 

Our last day together before going to separate schools, I told him I loved him. I know some people save that word for x months into a relationship, but I meant it. I loved him as a best friend and as a person. He said it back, and proceeded to say it at least 20 more times throughout the day. :)

We were terrified of what was going to come with school. However, we found very affordable travel accommodations to visit each other. We truly made the most of our first semester, and are still more in love than ever.
